title: Data and Business Analyst
text: Data and Business Analyst at Talent – Winner ‘Seek Large Recruitment Agency of the Year’ 3 consecutive years! (ACT, ; Full Time; salary: not stated). Data and Business Analyst An exciting requirement exists with our client, a large government department in Canberra for a highly skilled and experienced Data and Business Analyst. This is an initial short-term contract. CONTRACT POSITION - SHORT TERM COMPETITIVE RATE ON OFFER AUSTRALIAN CITIZENSHIP PREFERRED Application Requirements for Success: High level conceptual and analytical skills with the ability to interpret and analyze large complex datasets utilizing statistical tools such as SQL or SAS. Well-developed oral and written communication skills with high attention to detail. Proficient in the use of qualitative and quantitative research methodologies or data analytics. Well-developed organizational skills and an ability to work independently to achieve deadlines. To apply for this opportunity, please contact Jackson Bruce on 02 6285 3500 or jackson.bruce@talentinternational.com or click the "APPLY NOW' button below.
